_note: Explained disagreements with STEPBible TAHOT (verify_translit.py). max = token count at baseline 2026-10-08; growth or a new bucket >= category_floor fails the gate. 'ours' = which side is right.

STRESS table.why: TAHOT capitalises the syllable carrying a prepositive/postpositive accent (telisha gedola, yetiv, pashta), not the stressed one. Ours from the corpus stress table.

o>a | _>e.why: Qamats qatan + silent shva in Qal inf. cstr./impv. with suffix and qotl nouns (le`ovdah, chokhmah); TAHOT reads qamats gadol + vocal shva.

v>_.why: TAHOT drops spirant bet after holam (larov, ya`aqov -> la.Ro, ya.'a.Ko).

ye>i.why: Tiberian vocal shvas TAHOT reads silent: dropped dagesh forte after vav-consecutive (vayehi, vayedabber, vayevarekh; Lane 2026-10-08) or after ha- before a soft bgdkpt, and shva after a stressed long vowel in pause (layelah).

e>_.why: Vocal shva after a long vowel (toledot, yaledah, halekhu); TAHOT omits it. Also vav-consecutive before a guttural (vaye`annéha).

ay>_.why: Jerusalem qere perpetuum yerushalayim (patach+hiriq on lamed); TAHOT reads the ketiv -lim.

_>v.why: TAHOT writes the holam-male vav of the -o suffix as v (zar`o -> zar.'o/v), and Pentateuchal hi as hiv.

a>o.why: TAHOT writes stressed final qamats as o in -akh, -av and after prepositive accents (otakh, ha`am, besusav). Also prefix qamats before hatef qamats (barohatim, ha`omarim): TAHOT writes o.

STRESS accent.why: Word with a conjunctive + disjunctive accent: the last accent is the stress; TAHOT capitalises the first (va'avarekhkha, enenu).

_>e.why: Silent shva TAHOT voices: ushte (tav has dagesh), luqqachta, nachnu, word-final double shva (vayyevk).

o>a.why: Qamats qatan TAHOT reads as a: kol before maqqef, Qal inf. with suffix (akholkha), stress-retracted wayyiqtol (vayyaqom, vayyamot), golyat, yakholta. Lexical qatan in open syllable (qodashim, QATAN_OPEN).

_>o.why: TAHOT doubles holam before shin (enosh -> 'e.No.osh): encoding artifact.

STRESS default.why: Prepositive accent only, no table entry; ours final stress. TAHOT capitalises the prepositive accent's syllable. A few directional -ah forms (petorah) are genuinely unclear.

f>p.why: TAHOT writes undotted pe before final -eh as p (tissafeh, yefeh).

a>osh.why: Issachar: second (undotted) shin is silent; TAHOT garbles it.

y>i.why: Scheme: final -uy / -oy written y by us, i by TAHOT.

el>_.why: Shva under the first of two identical letters is vocal (halelu); TAHOT drops a syllable.

i>o.why: Ketiv/qere: TAHOT follows the other reading (tallinu / tallonu).

av>o.why: TAHOT drops final bet after qamats in zahav (za.ho): artifact.

_>ame | mo>_.why: Qal inf. cstr. with suffix: qamats qatan (keshom`o); TAHOT reads sha.me.

le>_.why: Vocal shva under the first of two identical letters (qilelatekha); TAHOT omits.

_>i.why: Source oddity: WLC points he with shva in vehenneh (Judg 3:25 and similar); TAHOT normalises to hiriq.

STRESS segolate.why: Segolate fallback (vayyitser): TAHOT capitalises the final syllable.

_>y.why: Scheme: TAHOT writes a glide before furtive patach after hiriq (yegia` -> ye.Gi.ya').

en>_.why: TAHOT drops a syllable in hineni (hi./Ni).

a>e.why: Ketiv/qere: TAHOT follows the other reading (vayyusam).

y>_.why: TAHOT drops the final yod of oy.

_>u.why: Ketiv/qere: TAHOT row is the other reading (vayyomer / vayyomeru).
